name: const unsafe fn as_ref_unchecked (& self) -> & T
rule: Calling `UnsafeCell::as_ref_unchecked` requires that no mutable reference to the wrapped value is alive.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::cell::UnsafeCell < T > { const unsafe fn as_ref_unchecked (& self) -> & T }
expression: The requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: it provides no observation for whether a mutable reference to the wrapped value is alive.
